securityDefinerTriggers.reason: ADR-0023 revision 2.5 section 27.9 (sealed at 424f85c283a543ba00a650ecc2ecc3a4346623df): the one enumerated B1 SECURITY DEFINER exception. This existing BEFORE INSERT trigger on kernel_private.execution_bindings performs a real UPDATE of kernel_private.release_epoch (epoch = epoch) to lock it and stamp the binding. As SECURITY DEFINER it does exactly the same work with the owner's rights, and neither runtime role holds any write on release_epoch or release_activations. Its body is not touched: B1 changes only its security attributes.
